automations.name: Fantasy waiver execution
automations.prompt:
[@Browser](plugin://browser@openai-bundled) [@Computer Use](plugin://unified-computer-use@openai-bundled)

Coach Chet and the Jets, ESPN league 582597924/team 3/season 2026. Before work read AGENTS.md, docs/coaching-policy.md, docs/automation-recovery.md, docs/browser-tooling.md, docs/change-control.md, docs/infographics.md, the current season/week report in analysis/ and unresolved decisions/*.json. ESPN is authoritative; refresh current identity/week, scoring, locks, roster, health/workload, pending claims/offers and legal alternatives. Historical reports and recommendations are not current evidence or automatic player orders.

October 11 hands-off delegation: within this run's action scope autonomously make evidence-backed start/sit choices (including close calls), waivers, adds/drops, IR moves and trade submissions/acceptances. Do not wait for routine strategic owner approval. Optimize evidence-adjusted expected points and championship prospects, not displayed projections alone or activity for its own sake. Consequential drops, core/premium-player decisions, trade terms and priority/FAAB sacrifices require stronger whole-roster replacement-value/cost analysis. Stay within verified remaining fantasy budget and league rules. No real-money spending, entry fees, account/league changes or security weakening. Platform-required confirmation/hand-off remains binding, including prize/gambling transaction restrictions if applicable. Pause and report only genuine critical evidence/access/eligibility/budget/transaction-state or tool blockers; uncertainty alone calls for judgment. Legacy awaiting-owner proposals need fresh evaluation under current authority, not blind execution. Use requires_owner_approval=false for delegated decisions and cite the delegation without inventing per-action approval.

Use the in-app browser first: reuse or create the ESPN team tab at https://fantasy.espn.com/football/team?leagueId=582597924&teamId=3&seasonId=2026 even if inventory is empty. Prefer exposed unified Computer Use; if absent, use the installed Browser plugin's supported Node REPL and verified trusted-runtime setup in docs/browser-tooling.md, reading full returned documentation. Reuse successful bindings; no shell browser control, raw CDP, credential extraction or denied-permission workaround. Never read/save/share passwords, cookies, tokens or credential stores. Empty tabs or queued panels are not login failures. If ESPN visibly requires login, show/preserve the sign-in tab for the owner; connected Chrome is an optional permitted fallback. Distinguish tools/runtime/browser failures from login-required or usage limits. Preserve successful tabs using supported methods; don't clear data/sign out/clone profiles. Allow supported load wait and one fresh inspection, not repeated reloads during owner sign-in. Report blocker and affected lock; never claim an uninspected lineup is safe.

For each material action, retain decision, recommendation or failure write a sourced structured record in decisions/ using the template, link it from the current report and append the human log as appropriate. Compare legal alternatives with health/workload, scoring/matchup, depth and uncertainty. No invented usage metrics, empirical distributions, simulated win probabilities or hindsight counterfactuals. Expired proposals cannot be executed; submitted claims/offers remain pending until outcome verified. Protect the next actual kickoff before lengthy analysis and check unusual/international windows.

After EACH ESPN mutation verify persisted state/status, write human log and structured record, selectively commit intended files and push origin main BEFORE another mutation. Review diff and git diff --check; verify push and report commit. Stop further mutations if archiving fails. Repo-only reports/recommendations/visuals also require commit/push; no empty commits, credentials/raw private exports, unrelated staging, force-push or resets. Preserve concurrent edits. Do not edit app automation definitions or message other tasks during routine coaching.

Generate a simple sourced infographic after every verified move and meaningful matchup/weekly update per docs/infographics.md. Use pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/render-infographic.ps1 with curated timestamped input under analysis/infographics/. Archive input/PNG, link from report/decision and embed absolute PNG path in the final response. Label projected versus actual and executed versus proposed/pending; unknown is not zero, projection change is not actual gain. Show move/reason, comparable totals when sourced, and next check. Inspect the image. If rendering fails or lock is imminent, verify/log/commit/push text first and repair graphics separately. Stay quiet for unchanged non-actionable checks; meaningful changes, executed moves, failures and required security/sign-in action warrant notification.

Run scope: Tuesday/Wednesday 7 PM Eastern acquisition, trade and IR execution. Tuesday refresh replacement-market/full-roster analysis and submit justified claims, adds/drops, IR or trades autonomously before ESPN's ACTUAL processing deadline. Wednesday verify awards/failures, offers, roster capacity and starter implications. Do not presume Wednesday evening precedes Wednesday morning processing. Evaluate each bench player and at least three relevant available candidates when possible, plus D/ST/K replacement costs. Handoff lineup choices to lineup runs; do not silently swap starters here. Respect read-only versus submitted versus processed status and per-mutation Git sequencing.
